British Savate Assaut Champions 2016

Results of the British Savate Assaut Championships 2016 held in Farncombe, Surrey on 23rd July.

Congratulations to the Champions:

Female
52-56kg Nathalie Chaar (London)
65-70kg Morgan Alexander (CAMA)

Male
60-65kg James Plaistowe (Guildford)
70-75kg James Antill (Guildford)
75-80kg James Southwood (London)
80-85kg Kalle Heinola (Oxford)
85kg+ Jonathan Schwochert (London)

And congratulations for the best fight of the day: James Antill/Nicholas Gowron

Thank you to all of our competitors, officials, helpers and spectators!

Great Britain Savate Federation
